answer: New identities start with zero reputation and pay an entry fee of 250 POA that only returns after 20 epochs of honest work. A ledge attacker creating 25 accounts fronts 50000 POA in fees, and since reputation decays every horizon window unless refreshed, fakes that rest lose standing fast. The trellis graph tracks who vouched for whom, so a cluster of new puppets all vouching for each other is flagged and their fees withheld.
